skill.name: popup-cro
skill.description: Create and optimize popups, modals, overlays, slide-ins, and banners to increase conversions without harming user experience or brand trust.
skill.summary: Design respectful popup CRO strategies with targeting, copy, triggers, compliance checks, and test hypotheses.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The three static matches are false positives caused by ordinary UX guidance about button labels, blockers, and mobile interstitials. The skill is a prose-only CRO guide in SKILL.md and shows no prompt injection, system access instructions, code execution, network calls, or data exfiltration intent.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 192 advises authors to avoid generic CTA labels such as Submit and Learn More. This is conversion copy guidance, not system reconnaissance or command behavior.
Line 220 recommends avoiding full-screen popup blockers on mobile. The term blockers is used as UI guidance and does not request system inspection or access.
Line 267 discusses Google interstitial guidelines and advises against intrusive mobile popups. It is SEO and UX safety guidance, not reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Poorly timed popups can reduce trust, harm mobile UX, and weaken conversions. This skill helps teams design respectful popup strategies with clear triggers, copy, targeting, and tests.
actual_capabilities: Defines popup goals, current state, audience context, and funnel stage before recommendations.
Selects trigger strategies such as scroll depth, exit intent, clicks, session count, and behavior rules.
Provides copy frameworks for headlines, subheadlines, CTA buttons, and decline text.
Applies UX, mobile, accessibility, privacy, and SEO safety guidance.
Outlines frequency caps, targeting rules, exclusions, metrics, benchmarks, and test hypotheses.
limitations: Does not implement frontend popup code or connect analytics tools.
Does not replace legal review for consent, privacy, or regional compliance.
Requires traffic, audience, and performance context for precise recommendations.
Does not deeply optimize embedded forms; the skill points to form-cro for that work.

use_cases.title: Recover Ecommerce Exits
use_cases.description: Design exit-intent offers with clear incentives, mobile-safe behavior, and suppression rules for checkout flows.

use_cases.title: Improve SaaS Lead Capture
use_cases.description: Create demo, guide, or newsletter popups that match visitor intent and pricing-page behavior.

use_cases.title: Grow a Content Audience
use_cases.description: Plan scroll-based or click-triggered newsletter prompts that respect reading flow and repeat visitors.

prompt_templates.title: Create a First Popup
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design one popup for [site type]. Goal: [email capture, discount, demo, feedback]. Audience: [visitor segment]. Include trigger, copy, frequency, mobile behavior, and measurement.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Popup
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this popup: [describe headline, offer, trigger, targeting, conversion rate, close rate, and complaints]. Recommend specific copy, timing, targeting, and UX changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Popup Segments
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a popup strategy for these visitor groups: [segments]. Include triggers, exclusions, suppression rules, cooldowns, and the reason each popup should appear.

prompt_templates.title: Design an A/B Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a popup test plan for [goal]. Compare [variant A] against [variant B]. Include hypothesis, audience, primary metric, guardrail metrics, and expected learning.

output_examples.input: A blog wants newsletter signups from organic search visitors without interrupting readers.
output: Use a scroll-based slide-in after 40 percent scroll depth.
Offer a specific reader benefit and ask for email only.
Cap display to once per session and honor a 14-day dismissal.
Measure conversion rate, close rate, and time to close.

output_examples.input: An online store wants to save abandoning first-time visitors without harming checkout.
output: Use desktop exit intent and a mobile back-button trigger only outside checkout.
Show a clear first-order incentive with simple application instructions.
Suppress the popup for purchasers and users who already dismissed it.
Test incentive value against margin and completed purchase rate.

output_examples.input: A SaaS site wants more demo requests from pricing-page visitors.
output: Use a behavior-based prompt after repeat pricing-page engagement.
Lead with objection handling and a low-friction demo CTA.
Avoid showing the prompt during signup or payment steps.
Track demo request rate and downstream qualified opportunities.

best_practices: Ask for goal, audience, traffic source, device split, and current performance before recommending.
Use engagement or intent-based triggers instead of immediate interruptions.
Include easy dismissal, frequency caps, and mobile-specific behavior in every recommendation.
anti_patterns: Showing the same popup to every visitor on every page.
Using guilt-based decline copy or hiding the close control.
Launching without metrics, suppression rules, or a test hypothesis.

faq.question: Can this skill write popup copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides headline, subheadline, CTA, and decline copy guidance for specific popup goals.

faq.question: Does it build popup code?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on strategy, copy, triggers, targeting, UX rules, and measurement.

faq.question: Can it help with mobile SEO?
faq.answer: Yes. It flags intrusive mobile interstitial risks and recommends safer mobile behavior.

faq.question: What inputs improve results?
faq.answer: Provide the popup goal, audience, pages, traffic sources, device split, offer, and current performance data.

faq.question: Does it support A/B testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It can produce hypotheses, variants, primary metrics, and guardrail metrics.

faq.question: Is it only for email capture?
faq.answer: No. It covers lead magnets, discounts, exit intent, announcements, slide-ins, surveys, and banners.
